# [Implementation] - `next` must report actionability from evidence (issue #337)

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #337 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

Every block runs from the worktree root, invokes this worktree's own built CLI
(`node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js"`), and writes only inside
`$HOME/.cache/agyloop/…`. Each block cleans up after itself. JSON is parsed with
`node`, never with a shell string comparison.

#### Check 1 — the build succeeds and the new strings exist

```bash
WT_ROOT="$(pwd)"
npm run build
node -e "
const d = require('./dist/domain');
const need = ['NOTE_IDLE_SUMMARY', 'NEW_LIFECYCLE_COMMAND', 'REOPEN_COMPLETED_COMMAND', 'NOTE_GATE_EVIDENCE_FILED', 'NOTE_DISCOVERY_COMPLETE', 'NOTE_PLAN_COMPLETE', 'NOTE_IMPLEMENT_PRESENT_REMEDIATION_PENDING', 'formatGateAdvanceCommand', 'formatGateEvidenceFiledNote', 'formatGateFailedRetryNote'];
const missing = need.filter((key) => !(key in d));
if (missing.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL missing domain exports: ' + missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1); }
if (d.NOTE_IDLE_SUMMARY.includes('codeloop <task>')) { console.error('FAIL the idle summary still names the placeholder'); process.exit(1); }
if (!d.NOTE_IDLE_SUMMARY.includes('codeloop plan --issue <n>')) { console.error('FAIL the idle summary names no real start command'); process.exit(1); }
console.log('new domain exports present and the idle summary names real commands');
"
```

#### Check 2 — `COMPLETED` and `INITIALIZED` are not actionable

```bash
WT_ROOT="$(pwd)"
SBX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-337-idle"
rm -rf "$SBX"
mkdir -p "$SBX/project/.agyloop/tasks" "$SBX/empty"
node - "$SBX/project/.agyloop/tasks/14.json" <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const now = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[2], JSON.stringify({
  version: '1.0.0', currentStage: 'COMPLETED', mode: 'standard', issue: 14,
  baseBranch: 'main', planDir: null, worktree: null,
  createdAt: now, updatedAt: now,
  history: [{ stage: 'COMPLETED', timestamp: now }],
  pausedAtGate: null, pausedAtTimestamp: null, totalHumanWaitMs: 0
}, null, 2));
JS
( cd "$SBX/project" && node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 14 --json > next-idle.json 2> next-idle.err )
node - "$SBX/project/next-idle.json" <<'JS'
const payload = JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
const fail = [];
if (payload.currentStage !== 'COMPLETED') fail.push('stage ' + payload.currentStage);
if (payload.actionType !== 'completed') fail.push('actionType ' + payload.actionType);
if (payload.actionable !== false) fail.push('actionable ' + payload.actionable);
if ('invocationPayload' in payload) fail.push('an idle directive carries a payload');
if (payload.pause !== null) fail.push('pause ' + JSON.stringify(payload.pause));
if (payload.humanSummary.includes('codeloop <task>')) fail.push('placeholder command');
if (!payload.humanSummary.includes('codeloop plan --issue')) fail.push('no real start command');
if (!payload.humanSummary.includes('codeloop next --restart --issue')) fail.push('no restart command');
if (fail.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL COMPLETED: ' + fail.join(' | ')); process.exit(1); }
console.log('COMPLETED: actionable=false, no payload, real commands named');
JS
( cd "$SBX/empty" && node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --json > next-init.json 2> next-init.err )
node - "$SBX/empty/next-init.json" <<'JS'
const payload = JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
const fail = [];
if (payload.currentStage !== 'INITIALIZED') fail.push('stage ' + payload.currentStage);
if (payload.actionType !== 'preflight') fail.push('actionType ' + payload.actionType);
if (payload.actionable !== false) fail.push('actionable ' + payload.actionable);
if ('invocationPayload' in payload) fail.push('a preflight directive carries a payload');
if (fail.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL INITIALIZED: ' + fail.join(' | ')); process.exit(1); }
console.log('INITIALIZED: actionable=false, no payload');
JS
if [ -e "$SBX/empty/.agyloop/tasks" ]; then
  echo "FAIL a query created a task checkpoint"
  exit 1
fi
rm -rf "$SBX"
```

#### Check 3 — DISCOVERY: blank dispatches, populated advances and writes nothing

```bash
WT_ROOT="$(pwd)"
SBX="$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-337-discovery"
rm -rf "$SBX"
mkdir -p "$SBX/.agyloop/tasks" "$SBX/artifacts/plans/9-task"
printf '# [Discovery] - Task\n\n## 1. Problem Statement & Symptoms\n- **Observed Behavior:**\n' > "$SBX/artifacts/plans/9-task/[Discovery] - Task.md"
node - "$SBX/.agyloop/tasks/9.json" "$SBX/artifacts/plans/9-task" <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const [file, planDir] = process.argv.slice(2);
const now = new Date().toISOString();
fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify({
  version: '1.0.0', currentStage: 'DISCOVERY', mode: 'standard', issue: 9,
  baseBranch: 'main', planDir, worktree: null,
  createdAt: now, updatedAt: now,
  history: [{ stage: 'DISCOVERY', timestamp: now }],
  pausedAtGate: null, pausedAtTimestamp: null, totalHumanWaitMs: 0
}, null, 2));
JS
( cd "$SBX" && node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 9 --json > blank.json 2> blank.err )
node - "$SBX/blank.json" <<'JS'
const payload = JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
const fail = [];
if (payload.actionable !== true) fail.push('actionable ' + payload.actionable);
if (payload.actionType !== 'subagent') fail.push('actionType ' + payload.actionType);
if (payload.role !== 'discovery') fail.push('role ' + payload.role);
if (!payload.invocationPayload) fail.push('no payload on a blank report');
if (payload.discoveryDispatchCount !== 1) fail.push('dispatch count ' + payload.discoveryDispatchCount);
if (fail.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL blank DISCOVERY: ' + fail.join(' | ')); process.exit(1); }
console.log('blank DISCOVERY: dispatchable, count 1');
JS
cat > "$SBX/artifacts/plans/9-task/[Discovery] - Task.md" <<'MD'
# [Discovery] - Task

## 1. Problem Statement & Symptoms
- **Observed Behavior:** the directive invited a dispatch after the report was populated.
- **Expected Behavior:** the directive names the advancing command and no payload is emitted.
- **Affected Components / Paths:** `src/application/get-next-action.ts`.

## 2. Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
- **Investigation Steps:** read `next` before and after writing the report.
- **Identified Failure Mode:** the payload was built before the report state was consulted.
- **Relevant Code References:** `get-next-action.ts:605-638`.

## 3. Reproduction Steps & Verification Protocol
- **Local Reproduction Command:** `codeloop next --issue 9 --json`
- **Failing Test Target:** `tests/presentation/cli-next-actionability.test.ts`

## 4. Remediation Strategy
- **Recommended Fix Approach:** return an `advance` directive when the report is populated.
- **Potential Regressions / Side Effects:** none when no generator is injected.
MD
cp "$SBX/.agyloop/tasks/9.json" "$SBX/before.json"
( cd "$SBX" && node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 9 --json > populated.json 2> populated.err )
node - "$SBX/populated.json" "$SBX/.agyloop/tasks/9.json" "$SBX/before.json" <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const [payloadFile, stateFile, beforeFile] = process.argv.slice(2);
const payload = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(payloadFile, 'utf8'));
const fail = [];
if (payload.actionable !== false) fail.push('actionable ' + payload.actionable);
if (payload.actionType !== 'advance') fail.push('actionType ' + payload.actionType);
if ('invocationPayload' in payload) fail.push('a completed stage carries a payload');
if ('role' in payload) fail.push('a completed stage names a role');
if (payload.discoveryReportPopulated !== true) fail.push('discoveryReportPopulated ' + payload.discoveryReportPopulated);
const text = payload.description + '\n' + payload.humanSummary;
if (!/do not re-dispatch discovery/i.test(text)) fail.push('no do-not-re-dispatch sentence');
if (!text.includes('codeloop plan --issue 9')) fail.push('advancing command missing');
if (fs.readFileSync(stateFile, 'utf8') !== fs.readFileSync(beforeFile, 'utf8')) fail.push('the met read wrote the checkpoint');
if (fail.length > 0) { console.error('FAIL populated DISCOVERY: ' + fail.join(' | ')); process.exit(1); }
console.log('populated DISCOVERY: advance, no payload, checkpoint byte-identical');
JS
rm -rf "$SBX"
```

GATE_REPORT_JSON:

  "testsStatus": "PASSED (12 passed)", "testsPassed": 12, "testsFailed": 0,
  "durationMs": 1000, "executedCommands": ["npm test"],

JSON
( cd "$SBX" && node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 14 --json > unfiled.json 2> unfiled.err )

const text = payload.description + '\n' + payload.humanSummary;
const fail = [];
if (payload.actionable !== false) fail.push('actionable ' + payload.actionable);
if (payload.actionType !== 'advance') fail.push('actionType ' + payload.actionType);

console.log('filed gate: advance, no payload, no filing note');
JS
( cd "$SBX" && node "$WT_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" transition REVIEW --issue 14 )
node - "$SBX/.agyloop/tasks/14.json" "$SBX/.agyloop/tasks/14.gate.json" <<'JS'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const [stateFile, evidenceFile] = process.argv.slice(2);
const state = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(stateFile, 'utf8'));
if (state.currentStage !== 'REVIEW') { console.error('FAIL the named command did not reach REVIEW: ' + state.currentStage); process.exit(1); }
const last = state.history[state.history.length - 1];
if (last.metadata.gateVerdict !== 'PASSED') { console.error('FAIL recorded verdict ' + JSON.stringify(last.metadata.gateVerdict)); process.exit(1); }
if (fs.existsSync(evidenceFile)) { console.error('FAIL evidence was not consumed'); process.exit(1); }
console.log('the named command is executable: REVIEW recorded PASSED and consumed the evidence');
JS
rm -rf "$SBX"
